newsitem.title: GERMANY: W.Germans pay 2.5 times more taxes than E.Germans.
newsitem.headline: W.Germans pay 2.5 times more taxes than E.Germans.

text.p: West Germans pay two and a half times the amount of taxes paid by their east German countrymen, Germany's Ifo institute said in a report on Monday.

On average, west Germans pay about 11,585 marks in taxes per year while east Germans pay about 4,765 marks, Ifo said, noting the government earned less than 10 percent of its revenues from taxpayers living eastern Germany.
Generous investment subsidies and tax breaks in east German states explained the figures, the Munich-based research institute said.
Taxpayers in Saxony, one of Germany's most industrialised areas before World War Two, pay the most taxes of all people living in eastern Germany while those in east Berlin pay the least, Ifo said.
